_notes: Drop this into %APPDATA%\context-harness\config.json (merge with your existing settings, don't overwrite blindly). The key itself NEVER goes in this file. Put it in a .env next to it or in your project dir: LLAMA_API_KEY=<your key>. Start llama-server with the same key: --api-key <your key>. Confirm these three before use: base_url (if your server isn't 127.0.0.1:8080), model (the id your server reports), and the env var name. budget_hard/budget_soft are omitted on purpose: the harness live-detects your context window from the server.
